note: Rewritten from the species-level description in Maiti (Memoirs of the Zoological Survey of India, a world monograph of the termite genera); the original is in English; no specimens being available, both the description and the measurements follow Snyder 1926; three sections, alate, major soldier and minor soldier. OCR problems: 'brbadest' in the minor soldier is read as broadest; the ratio of the alate pronotum length 3.00 to its width 2.10 is doubtful but is transcribed unchanged.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head pale yellowish brown, clypeus darker; head slightly longer than wide, sides rounded, slightly narrowed posteriorly. The horn (clypeus) is outlined by a V-shaped groove running from the fontanelle, long and wide, with a median groove. Fontanelle semi-transparent, small, round, its opening situated far forwards. Compound eyes black, nearly circular, protruding, close to the lateral margin of the head. Ocelli semi-transparent, suboval, separate from each other, their distance from the compound eyes less than their diameter. Antennae 20-segmented, segment 3 slender and long, longer than segments 4 and 5 together. Pronotum subrectangular, slightly saddle-shaped, angles rounded, posterior margin slightly concave, margins with long hairs. Forewing scale longer than the pronotum, hindwing scale shorter than the pronotum. Wings grey, costa golden brown. In the forewing the media is parallel and close to the cubital branches, both reaching the wing apex; subcosta with a few branches near the apex. In the hindwing the media is parallel and close to the cubitus, its distance from the subcosta greater than in the forewing; cubitus not reaching the wing apex, with numerous branches to the posterior margin of the wing.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Major soldier: head yellowish brown, flat, longer than wide, widest posteriorly, posterior lateral angles narrow, with scattered long hairs. Fontanelle small, with a groove running from the opening to the labrum. Labrum tongue-shaped, as long as wide, with a median groove, apex white, fleshy, broadly rounded, with short hairs. Left mandible with 2 sharp marginal teeth near the middle, the first larger than the second; the upper tooth of the right mandible near the middle, indistinct; the lower tooth prominent and sharp, near the base. Antennae 18-segmented, segment 2 short, segments 3 and 4 about equal in length. Pronotum yellowish brown, anterior margin raised, slightly notched.
Minor soldier: head pale yellowish brown, longer than wide, widest anteriorly, sides incurved and sloping backwards, posterior margin rounded. Postclypeus and labrum prolonged into a pale chestnut-brown sclerotised rod, apex forked, base narrow, widening towards the apex, with a median longitudinal groove, apex notched; the forked end densely covered with short hairs, the base of the rod with a few long hairs; the fontanelle gives rise to a short truncate tube pointing into the deep clypeal groove. Mandibles slender and long. Antennae 16-segmented, segment 3 twice segment 4, segment 2 longer than segment 4. Pronotum with the anterior margin raised, sides sloping backwards, posterior margin concave, with long hairs.
Measurements (major soldier / minor soldier): head length 2.50 / 1.40—1.45 mm; head width 2.35—2.45 / 1.05—1.10 mm; labrum length 0.76 / 0.95 mm; labrum width 0.70 / —; mandible length 1.00 / 0.37 mm; pronotum length 0.80 / 0.60 mm; pronotum width 1.50 / 0.85 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Measurements (alate, after Snyder 1926): total length 18.00 mm; body length without wings 10.05 mm; head length 2.40 mm; head width 2.35 mm; pronotum length 3.00 mm, width 2.10 mm; forewing length 18.05 mm, width 3.50 mm; compound eye diameter 0.62 mm.
